blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Bataan Rep. Albert Garcia said on Thursday that the House of Representatives incorporated a provision into the P7.2-trillion budget bill authorizing corrections to clerical errors in blueprint details. Garcia, the senior vice chairman of the House Appropriations Committee, said a special provision was added into the budget of the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) to rectify flawed project details. He believes this remedy will clear hurdles for a handful of farm-to-market road projects at risk of stalling because of erroneous coordinates, he pointed out. “There’s a special provision that we have with HGAB that the agency […]...
